grammar.summary: 本课学习 so that 目的状语从句。

points.title: so that 目的从句
points.explanation: He made me take him out... so that 表目的：so that + 从句（常含 could/would）。与 so...that（结果）区分。

examples.en: He barked so that someone would let him out.
examples.cn: 它叫个不停，好让人放它出去。

points.title: develop a habit 表"养成习惯"
points.explanation: Since then, he has developed another bad habit. 现在完成时表习惯已形成。

examples.en: My dog has developed a bad habit.
